---
title: "ROS 2 + PX4 Dev Guide"
---

A self-contained reference for setting up a ROS 2 (Jazzy) workspace targeting
PX4 SITL, using **pixi** as the environment manager and **basedpyright** for
Python type checking. No system-level ROS install required.

## Contents

| Guide | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| [Workspace Setup](docs/setup/workspace-setup.qmd) | pixi.toml, channels, dependencies, activation, submodules, build tasks |
| [Type Checking](docs/tooling/basedpyright.qmd) | basedpyright configuration, pixi env resolution, ROS-specific notes, VSCode |

## Stack overview

```{mermaid}
graph LR
    pixi["pixi\n(env manager)"] --> ros["ROS 2 Jazzy\n(robostack-jazzy)"]
    pixi --> cuda["CUDA 12+\n(conda-forge)"]
    pixi --> python["Python 3.11+\n(conda-forge)"]
    ros --> colcon["colcon build"]
    colcon --> ws["install/\n(ROS overlay)"]
    ws --> px4["px4_msgs\n(git submodule)"]
```

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Notes |
|-------------|-------|
| **pixi** | `curl -fsSL https://pixi.sh/install.sh \| bash` |
| **CUDA 12+** | Host driver >= 525; `nvcc` is installed by pixi |
| **git** | For submodule management |
